data.one_liner: Phosphor Icons library for Flutter with 1500+ icons in 6 styles, fully compatible with Dart 3.x.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 1500 icons across six weight styles (thin, light, regular, bold, fill, duotone) for Flutter applications. It is built as a drop-in, Dart 3.x compatible replacement for older phosphor icon packages, featuring tree-shaking support and a custom PhosphorIcon widget for duotone rendering.
use_when: You need a comprehensive icon set with multiple weights like thin, bold, and duotone.
You are migrating away from the deprecated phosphor_flutter package due to Dart 3.x compatibility issues.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material design icons.
Your project uses an icon set that is already covered by alternative packages like font_awesome_flutter or lucide_icons_flutter.
strengths: Fully compatible with Dart 3.x without extending final classes.
Includes duotone support via a custom PhosphorIcon widget with color and opacity controls.
weaknesses: Duotone icons require a custom PhosphorIcon widget rather than the standard Flutter Icon widget.
Adds external icon font assets to your bundle.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the widely used Font Awesome icon library instead of Phosphor Icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean Lucide icon set.
